blocking_findings.finding: Watcher treats every state outside RUNNING/PENDING/CONFIGURING/COMPLETING as terminal, including nonterminal SUSPENDED. A transient sacct failure exits the loop without a record; postKFD timeout raises before writing watcher.json. Launcher starts GPU process before confirming watcher readiness. Thus the claimed independent any-actual-terminal postKFD guarantee is not yet fail-closed.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Use explicit normalized terminal states; treat other states as observation-only. Persist observer failures and continue same handle without resubmission. Wrap postKFD result/timeout in a persisted final record and require successful parsed passed/node evidence before adoption. Establish watcher-ready receipt before launching numerical work, or equivalent independently supervised lifecycle coverage.
blocking_findings.boundary: For an observed genuine terminal and successful subprocess calls, existing finally correctly attempts postKFD even when audit fails and on nonzero terminal exit. No automatic rerun is proposed.
